records.admission_verdict: Experimental, not executable. Official dataset guide describes Alpaca, ShareGPT, and ChatML conventions consumed through Python load_dataset, get_chat_template, and TRL SFTTrainer. There is no stable machine-checkable destination file tree independent of model chat templates. Item 10.5 skipped Unsloth with this explicit non-admission record.
records.deprecation_policy: Re-review when Unsloth publishes a versioned, file-level dataset contract that a later pin can check without a model tokenizer.
records.loader: Not executable. Unsloth notebooks load Hugging Face datasets or JSON and apply tokenizer chat templates. Extra unsloth stays empty.
records.loss_notes: Unsloth SFT typically trains completions after a chat template. That template is model-bound and is not a Veriformis loss-policy ID. This pin does not authorize an emit.
